description:
Step into contemporary city living with our highly sought-after stylish apartments at Triangle Yard in Leeds City Centre!

Offering a selection of stunning 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, these homes boast top-tier amenities including a state-of-the-art gym and a dedicated co-working space, all situated in a prime, highly sought-after location

**Must have signed up by 30th Sept 2026 and moved in by 18th October 2026 to get £1,000 off your 3rd month's rent**
